style: Avant-garde chamber-folk art-rock and ritual microtonal ensemble. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Polyharmonic quartal suspension fields with microtonal pure-interval friction and sliding subharmonic drone layers. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Clipped phonetic consonant runs, alveolar trills, front-rounded vowels, and phrase-level prominence peaks. [RHYTHM SYSTEM] 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, double-time hallucination, asymmetric meter collisions, and motorik pulse. [TIMBRE SYSTEM] Tagelharpa bowed lyre, qanun zither, udu clay drums, balafon, wavetable synths, and subtractive resonance. [PERFORMANCE] Breathless hype delivery paired with deep bewilderment headspace. [ANCHOR] A raw 5-beat rhythmic cell returning scarred across transformations. [TEXTURE EXPANSION] Microscopic grain delays cascading over plucked zither harmonics to generate spatial distortion fields. [ACOUSTIC REFRACTION] Dynamic transient envelopes warping spatial coordinates continuously in real-time across acoustic planes.
lyrics: [Intro — Darbuka and Tagelharpa Drone] [Tempo: 124 BPM, 3:2 Coupling Active] [Voice 1 — Spoken with Pharyngeal Emphatic Consonants and Alveolar Trills] Why do I lose everything all the time? [Drum roll on Djembe] [Udu air-bloom bass sub-pulse] [Verse 1 — Qanun Arpeggios and Subtractive Lead] Every clock hand snaps before the hour arrives! Keys dissolve in pockets like spun sugar! The map ink smears into absolute mud! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Choir Possession Enters — Antiphonal Counterpoint Lattice] [Choir] Where does the afternoon go when the room tilts sideways? [Voice 1] I set the cup down and the ceramic table vaporizes! [Choir] It evaporates into pure numberless air! [Voice 1] Why do I lose everything all the time? [Chorus — Full Ensemble: Balafon, Qanun, Tagelharpa, Darbuka] [3:2 Meter Collision: 3+3 against 2+2+2] [Choir and Lead in Luminous Friction Harmony] Look at the floorboards! They are sliding like cards! Look at the calendar! The months are shedding their leaves like dying birds! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Interlude — Jurisdiction Dropout: Harmonica and Bass Cutout, leaving only Udu clicks and Tagelharpa bows] [Double-Time Hallucination: Percussion runs at double speed while pulse holds] [Verse 2 — Spoken with Front-Rounded Vowels and Nasal Resonance] The memories were bolted with iron pins! Now the pins are rust and the rust is floating away! I had a name yesterday and today it is just a shape in the corner! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Bridge — Breathless Hype Delivery Escalating] Wait! Stop! There is another reveal coming right behind this one! The wall is opening! No, the wall was never there! It was an illusion of the corridor! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Choir Hocketed Exchange] [Voice 2] Did you check the drawer? [Voice 3] The drawer is a portal to an empty room! [Voice 1] Did you check your hands? [Voice 1] My hands are transparent and slipping through the grain! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Extended Verse 3 — Microtonal Friction and Zither Resonance] The shoes wear out against the floor before the morning walk is finished! The lint in the pocket turns into grey moths that fly toward the ceiling vent! I had a face in the mirror and now the glass is merely silver water running down the tiles! The address book pages tear themselves out and fold into tiny paper boats that sail down the gutter! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Bridge 2 — Rapid Percussive Stutter and Udu Slaps] The ceiling is dropping inches every minute! The ceiling light bulb falls into my soup and cools instantly! The bedsheets unravel into giant skeins of grey yarn that wrap around my shins! I tried to hold the water in cupped palms and it became dry sand before reaching my mouth! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Additional Verse 4 — Quantum Decay Sub-Routine] The radio stations broadcast silence wrapped in static wool! The telephone wires snap into coiled snakes that slither underground! Every photograph I touch turns instantly into blank white parchment! The shadow of my body refuses to follow me across the threshold! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Additional Verse 5 — Spatial Erosion Loop] The pocket watch ticks backward until the gears disintegrate into copper dust! The letters written to my family become transparent films that dissolve in the morning dew! The staircase loses its risers one by one until only vertical drops remain! Why do I lose everything all the time? [Climax — Perpetual Uplift with Wavetable Resonance Sweep] [All Sound Sources Active: Djembe, Balafon, Qanun, Udu, Tagelharpa, Subtractive Synth] [Choir Counterpoint Lactic Density Peak] Why do I lose everything all the time?! Everything is sliding down the vertical glass! Catch the second hand! Catch the shadow before it hits the floor! Why do I lose everything all the time?! [Outro — Sudden Drop to Single Bowed Tagelharpa Drone and Udu Tap] [Bewilderment Headspace Spoken Softly with Alveolar Trill] I had the answer in my palm. Now there is only the space where the palm used to be. Why do I lose everything all the time? [Final silent micro-pause]
caption: An avant-garde chamber-folk art-rock journey driven by 3:2 cross-rhythms, polyharmonic quartal suspension fields, and an obsessive vocal delivery. Utilizing tagelharpa, qanun, udu, and wavetable synthesis, the piece explores profound bewilderment and breathtaking loss through rigorous microtonal friction, hocketed choral counterpoint, and relentless forward kinetic energy. Every sonic gesture disintegrates mid-phrase, reinforcing a thematic obsession with permanent vanishing and fading identity
